sloka: अलङ्कारं पुरस्त्यवं कृत्वा तत्पुरवासिनः ।आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् ॥२-६-१९॥
transliteration: alaṅkāraṁ purastyavaṁ kṛtvā tatpuravāsinaḥ ।ākāṅkṣamāṇā rāmasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam ॥2-6-19॥

translations.english: Thus the residents of Ayodhya decorated the city and eagerly waited for Rama's cornonation as heirapparent. Gathered in groups at public squares and in the assembly halls they conversed among themselves about the event, praising Dasaratha, the lord among men.
translations.hindi: शकलीकृतः--सर्वाङ्ग घुविक्षतः ( रा० ) पप ne थे कपा तब तु स्नेहान्मनसा धार्यते मया | ब रामाभिषेकसम्भारानिग्र्म विनिवर्तय
